target_customer: Financial service providers (banks, fintechs, payment firms) onboarding business customers
problem: Know-your-business onboarding checks require slow manual review; TrueBiz compiles 250+ web data points and risk indicators in seconds.
business_model: B2B SaaS / API (per-check, pricing not found)

founders.name: Danny Hakimian
prior_employers: Onfido (6 years leading US enterprise sales)
founders.background_notes: Sales background per search summary of the seed post.

founders.name: Max Morlocke
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in a secondary summary; not listed on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and cleaning 250+ data points about businesses from across the web and summarizing risk indicators is a data engineering and ML task with hard entity-resolution parts, but uses existing techniques.

defensibility.rationale: Compliance workflow integration can create switching costs and an accumulated web dataset helps, but data is public-web derived and could be replicated by well-funded KYB vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbents copying or acquiring TrueBiz; still active per YC listing.

market_need_then: Seed backers (Flourish Ventures) framed it as building KYB infrastructure; the YC page cites manual review of business onboarding as the pain. No dated spend figures found.
outcome_analysis: TrueBiz is active with a small team and raised a $2.4M seed in January 2023 led by Flourish Ventures, after the Summer 2022 batch. No Series A or exit was found, so it has neither clearly succeeded nor stalled. Hiring for sales and enterprise roles suggests an effort to scale go-to-market, but sources do not give revenue or customer traction.
notes: Homebrew and TrueBiz blog pages returned 404 on direct fetch; seed details taken from search result summaries. One source mentions $2.9M total including the seed, unconfirmed. Hakimian technical=false inferred from stated sales role. Competitors at founding not found.
